TasteTable

A weekly plan of restaurants + one cultural outing, grounded in Qloo taste data and checked against care constraints.

Not medical or dietary advice. Constraint checks are heuristics over public venue tags and menu keywords. Always confirm accessibility, texture and sodium needs with the venue and the person's care team. Sample personas are fictional; do not enter real health information.
